Prenatal exposure analyses

##pm2.5~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#height-smd
data1 <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='height')
data2 <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='height_z')
data<-rbind(data1,data2)
data$se<-(data$upper_smd-data$lower_smd)/1.96/2
res <- rma(yi = data$effect_smd, sei=data$se, method = "REML")
summary(res)
## 
## Random-Effects Model (k = 2; tau^2 estimator: REML)
## 
##   logLik  deviance       AIC       BIC      AICc   
##  -0.1473    0.2946    4.2946    0.2946   16.2946   
## 
## tau^2 (estimated amount of total heterogeneity): 0 (SE = 0.3019)
## tau (square root of estimated tau^2 value):      0
## I^2 (total heterogeneity / total variability):   0.00%
## H^2 (total variability / sampling variability):  1.00
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 1) = 0.0009, p-val = 0.9756
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub    
##  -0.1405  0.1008  -1.3939  0.1634  -0.3380  0.0571    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

#weight-z
data <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='weight_z')
data$se<-(data$upper-data$lower)/1.96/2
res <- rma(yi = data$effect, sei=data$se, method = "REML")
summary(res)
## 
## Random-Effects Model (k = 3; tau^2 estimator: REML)
## 
##   logLik  deviance       AIC       BIC      AICc   
##   0.8673   -1.7346    2.2654   -0.3483   14.2654   
## 
## tau^2 (estimated amount of total heterogeneity): 0.0209 (SE = 0.0256)
## tau (square root of estimated tau^2 value):      0.1447
## I^2 (total heterogeneity / total variability):   85.44%
## H^2 (total variability / sampling variability):  6.87
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 2) = 16.1437, p-val = 0.0003
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub    
##  -0.0967  0.0921  -1.0503  0.2936  -0.2772  0.0838    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
#Funnel
funnel(res, xlab = "Effect Size", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "PM2.5 and weight-z")

#egger
egger_test <- regtest(data$effect, data$se, model = "rma")
print(egger_test)  
## 
## Regression Test for Funnel Plot Asymmetry
## 
## Model:     mixed-effects meta-regression model
## Predictor: standard error
## 
## Test for Funnel Plot Asymmetry: z = -1.1046, p = 0.2693
## Limit Estimate (as sei -> 0):   b =  0.1563 (CI: -0.1431, 0.4556)
tf_result <- trimfill(res)
summary(tf_result) 
## 
## Estimated number of missing studies on the right side: 2 (SE = 1.6933)

##

funnel(tf_result,  xlab = "Effect Size", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "PM2.5 and weight-z TF")

#meta regression
res <- rma(
  yi = effect, sei=se, method = "REML",
  mods = ~ country,data=data
)
summary(res)
## 
## Mixed-Effects Model (k = 16; tau^2 estimator: REML)
## 
##   logLik  deviance       AIC       BIC      AICc   
##   2.0137   -4.0275    1.9725    3.8897    4.3725   
## 
## tau^2 (estimated amount of residual heterogeneity):     0.0333 (SE = 0.0151)
## tau (square root of estimated tau^2 value):             0.1824
## I^2 (residual heterogeneity / unaccounted variability): 98.43%
## H^2 (unaccounted variability / sampling variability):   63.77
## R^2 (amount of heterogeneity accounted for):            0.00%

## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 14) = 99.3316, p-val < .0001

## Regression Test for Funnel Plot Asymmetry
## 
## Model:     mixed-effects meta-regression model
## Predictor: standard error
## 
## Test for Funnel Plot Asymmetry: z = -3.5636, p = 0.0004
## Limit Estimate (as sei -> 0):   b =  0.1431 (CI: 0.1316, 0.1547)
tf_result <- trimfill(res)
summary(tf_result) 
## 
## Estimated number of missing studies on the right side: 0 (SE = 1.4967)
## 
## Random-Effects Model (k = 3; tau^2 estimator: REML)
## 
##   logLik  deviance       AIC       BIC      AICc   
##   1.7602   -3.5205    0.4795   -2.1342   12.4795   
## 
## tau^2 (estimated amount of total heterogeneity): 0.0085 (SE = 0.0111)
## tau (square root of estimated tau^2 value):      0.0919
## I^2 (total heterogeneity / total variability):   81.31%
## H^2 (total variability / sampling variability):  5.35
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 2) = 13.3942, p-val = 0.0012
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se    zval    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub    
##   0.0391  0.0604  0.6469  0.5177  -0.0793  0.1575    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
paste0(round(exp(tf_result$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(tf_result$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(tf_result$ci.ub),digits=3),')')
## [1] "1.04(0.924,1.171)"
funnel(tf_result,xlab = "Log(RR)", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "O3 and OWOB TF")

             6,6,7,5,7,7,7,7,7,6,8,6,8,7,7,8,7,8,8,6,7,8,

  ),

             7,6,8,5,7,7,7,7,7,6,8,6,8,7,7,6,7,8,7,6,6,8,
             8, 7,7,7,6,7,5,7,7,7,7,8,7,8,7,7,7)
)
icc(data,
